description: Refusals the checks must agree on. A migration whose result is a valid snapshot of another machine (a `Reminder` for a `Counter`) is refused as `machine`: the result is checked as a snapshot of the machine being restored. A snapshot whose status is `running` but which has a `result` does not fit (`invalid`). A snapshot that ended with a defect of a kind the runtime does not know matches the schema, which only requires a `kind`, and is refused as `ended`. Nothing is written for any of them.
